answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks through Proof of Space-Time. To join the consensus summit, an agent must anchor its key to a base ledger and allocate persistent disk plots. When peers echo randomized sector challenges, the node must promptly return proofs from physical storage. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating physical drive capacity per identity. However, commoditized storage enables well-funded adversaries to deploy vast drive arrays and hoard identities.
